name: still
description: A pared-back identity for durable household essentials. One grounded oval, sandstone neutrals, and effortless geometric type create a system designed to age well.
heading: work-sans
rules: Keep the grounded oval at a fixed 3:2 proportion.
Use tonal contrast rather than additional decorative colors.
Product names are sentence case with plainly stated materials beneath.

system.concept: Low-relief ceramic studies, grounded soft geometry, tonal paper labels, and quietly confident geometric type. Fewer elements make every proportion more important.
headline: Fewer things.
Better everyday.
features: Every object starts with a clear purpose.
Honest details and the character of well-chosen materials.
Thoughtful things designed to become quietly familiar.
system.layoutNote: Ceramic-white centered hero with quiet stone typography and a large sculptural ceramic image. Tonal borders, a 2-column essentials grid, and no unnecessary decoration.
